description: Line coverage sign-off exclusions for the accelerator VCS VDB fallback parser. The excluded bins are simulation-only trace hooks, defensive error paths, generated-lane clamp alternatives checked by end-to-end directed tests, and parameter-arm bookkeeping that is covered by the configuration sweep rather than by every fixed elaboration.

exclude.reason: performance trace counters and trace enables
reuse-parameter case arms covered by directed configuration sweep
generated-lane clamp alternatives checked by saturation regressions
idle/backpressure cleanup paths not part of forward-progress sign-off
top fixed-ready completion and AXI error-response defensive paths

exclude.pattern: cfg_last_group_width = count_t\x27\(1\)|first_group_width = tile_cols_total|first_group_width = count_t\x27\(1\)|valid_n_rows = count_t\x27\(1\)|valid_m_cols = count_t\x27\(1\)|dma_beats_per_row = 32\x27\(1\)
exclude.reason: illegal or software-normalized reuse geometry guards
defensive tail and unaligned buffer guard paths
